snippet.title: Labyrinthine Console Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014325

Labyrinthine Console Edition — AVAILABLE NOW on PlayStation 5 with cross-platform multiplayer support! 🎮👻

The acclaimed co-op horror experience includes:

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Co-op for up to 8 players or solo play
📖 Story Mode & Case Files with procedurally generated mazes
👹 Over 30 unique monsters with deadly mechanics
🧥 Hundreds of cosmetics to customize your character

#ps5 #ps5games #labyrinthine 

Rated Mature
